text:
jamal: Heads-up — thinking about delegating ownership of routing-variant flags to product teams. Question: how do we ensure they can't silently flip a variant that bypasses quota safeguards? Need telemetry hooks and an ops kill-switch.

kat: Strong +1 for ops kill-switch. We'd want console-visible audit + rollout windows. Maybe require `safemode: true` for initial 24h.

alex: propose: per-flag metadata fields: owners, allowed_variants, emergency_pause=true, telemetry_hooks=[...]

maria: +1. Also need automatic KPIs: latency_delta, token_cost_delta, error_rate. Dashboards auto-created on first rollout.

liam: who owns the dashboard creation? We can add a webhook that triggers infra to create a Grafana panel; but needs permissions.

jamal: idea: add `delegation_scope` enum: global|team|service. Team level can only change allowed_variants, not rollout_percentage.

kat: can we enforce via API — console submits change goes to `review:pending` if it touches rollout_percentage > 10% or expands variants.

alex: sample rule:
```
flag:
  name: route_by_variant
  owners: ["team-tracing"]
  delegation_scope: team
  safemode: true
  rollout_limit: 0.10
```

maria: ops-bot: @ops-bot can we get an alert if rollout exceeds limit? (this is a ping to bot)

ops-bot: @maria acknowledged — will add watch on route_by_variant for >10% with slack notify to #eng-oncall.

liam: we still need an audit trail of console previews vs applied. Right now console shows 'preview' but no persisted preview object.

jamal: agreed — require `preview_id` stored and linked to change. Also retention 90 days.

kat: one more: telemetry hooks should include a sampling config so we don't flood metrics when flag impacts 0.1% traffic.

alex: ok I'll draft an RFC for `flag-delegation-v2` with fields: delegation_scope, rollout_limit, telemetry_hooks, emergency_pause, preview_id. I'll ping owners list.

maria: sweet. can we add a "safety-score" computed on rollout that combines telemetry deltas? helps console coloring.

jamal: love that. thanks all. deploying a tiny experiment for team-tracing tomorrow morning. I'll followup with the RFC link.
